title: Publish a gallery of 8 ready-made Zedu workspace templates by Fri 20 Nov
description: A blank workspace is the hardest part of starting. Templates show people how to set Zedu up for their situation in minutes. Write 8 templates: a 12-week bootcamp cohort, a university course, a secondary school class, a study group, a hackathon, a community of practice, a small startup team, and an internship programme. Each template lists the channels to create and what each is for, the roles and who gets them, pinned messages and first posts to copy, and a weekly routine, all using features that exist in the live app today. Each also gets a short page intro, title and meta description so the gallery can rank for "how to organise a ... online". Done when: 8 templates are written, checked against the live app and reviewed.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: 8 templates built and tested in a real Zedu workspace before they're written up
acceptedWorkstreams.description: For each of the 8 situations (12-week bootcamp, university course, secondary class, study group, hackathon, community of practice, startup team, internship), build the template in an actual Zedu workspace first: the channels, what each is for, the pinned welcome message, roles and a first-week checklist. Then write it up with screenshots from that workspace, so every template is proven to work in the product as it is today, not just described. Each template ends with the exact steps to recreate it.
